title: Early shuttle crews borrowed yellow U-2/SR-71 suits from Beale
place_text: Beale Air Force Base / Kennedy Space Center

tellings.quote: they had to go to Beal Air Force Base and borrow the yellow space suits that the U2 and SR71 guys fly.

plain: For the first space shuttle flights in 1981, the astronauts Young and Krippen had no suits of their own and had to go to Beale Air Force Base to borrow the yellow pressure suits worn by pilots of the U-2 and SR-71, high-altitude spy planes. A NASA doctor named Greg Rogers tells Michels this from what he heard on the job. It shows how much the early shuttle program leaned on secret military aviation.
